text: Architecture is an integrated discipline that combines artistic creativity, engineering technology and humanities and social sciences, aiming to cultivate professional talents with the capabilities of architectural design, planning, construction and management. The curriculum system takes architectural design as its core and covers multi-dimensional knowledge such as aesthetic theory, structural mechanics, materials science, and urban planning. It emphasizes the integration of spatial thinking, technical practice, and innovation ability to address the coordination issues of architectural function, form, environment, and social demands.
